request.description: The signed-in user's update channels; every channel is on until the user changes it (`version` 0). Channels for case and work updates (application status, analysis results, document requests, lead offers, payouts). Security and consent messages (sign-in and consent codes, invitations, consent links) are always sent. At least one of SMS, email or push stays on. WhatsApp and marketing opt-ins are consents: use `POST /me/consents` and `POST /me/consents/:purpose/withdraw`. Any context.
